{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''cabby''' [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] in [[Drev'starn]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the Bothan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. The Bothan was talkative and accurately claimed that he knew Drev'starn like the [[Color/Legends|color]] of his [[Hair/Legends|fur]].

He taxied a group of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[operative]]s around town while they were on a mission there, flying them from the [[Drev'starn Spaceport]] to a [[Bothan hotel]]. As many other locals, he mistook [[Unidentified courier lookalike|one of them]] for a notorious [[Unidentified crime syndicate courier|crime syndicate member]].

He flew them to a warehouse in a business district for an appointment which went bad, as one criminal faction fell for the similarity. On their way back to the hotel, they were chased by three [[Limousine/Legends|limo-speeders]], who attempted to force them off the road; they were members of a [[Rodian/Sullustan crime syndicate]], who were also after the lookalike. The chase took them to back streets, across wide plaza strips, a park, and pedestrian walkways, alarming the local police.

That evening, the cabby drove them to the ''[[Stone Grotto]]'' across the city. He made sure to let them know about its strict dress code and offered to help them purchase the proper attire.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=A Case of Mistaken Identities|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

Around the same time, he drove trade delegates on a limo-speeder to [[Consul-General Pring's diplomatic estate]] for one of his lavish soirées. The delegates were actually Rebel operatives on their way for a defection and extraction mission. He and other drivers waited in a special lounge prepared for them, and didn't have to be [[Weapon detector|scanned for weapons]].<ref>{{WEGCite|story=An Invitation to Defect|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
It is up to the players and the gamemaster whether the cabby will be available to drive them to their destinations, as they have other options. The above article includes the scenario's suggestions.
